title: Prove H4 block minrank 15 and root-linear COPY floor 52
body:
The 60 H4 root lines suggest a four-dimensional replacement for the selected E8 geometry. I prove exact block fitting rank **15k over every field**, then a **COPY floor of 52** for root-linear Gram factorizations with any finite number of scalar terms. Under the retained coverage, compressed-window and halving conditions, I derive **a < 0.001** for all stage counts. This excludes this supplier class as an improvement; it does not improve the multiplication exponent.

The characteristic-two proof uses five explicit 13-cliques whose symmetric difference is a 5-clique, applying Thiago Goulart / @Tuafo's clique-idempotent method from PR1744. Fifteen orthogonal tetrads attain the bound. Outside characteristic two, a complementary rank-four Gram matrix gives the same lower bound. For the COPY floor, I enumerate 1,320 hyperplanes and check 5,280 representative support intersections covering all 1,742,400 ordered pairs through exact reflections.

Validation: Python 3.12 registered replay and Python 3.14.6 isolated `-O` replay pass, including eight corruption controls and exact integer rejection at a=0.001. Support receipt: `8b0a00c1e8bc012e7f9b620e0ed2c23384f08ea51f7a023f03279e34e9704ab6`. The proof requires review of its universal linear-algebra and accounting steps; finite replay is not a formal multiplication proof. The overcomplete COPY result retains root-linear factors, and the moment conclusion retains one unpaid coordinate and the stated staging model.

GitHub reports `action_required` for the fork workflows, including [Registered research packages](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38562980680). I claim the local passes above, not a hosted CI pass.

Base: current main `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`. Coordination: [Discussion1860](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1860). I preserve credit for Denney et al., Bao et al., @Tuafo, Joel Pulikkan / @GamingPuzzled, DreamingOfClouds and the coverage/packing lineage in the package and pinned sources. No literature-priority claim.

Jose Manuel / @jmbarrancoml, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, proof, implementation and prose. No independent human review claimed.
